targetSurface: People's Court Partner API v2 + @peoples-court/x402-disputes (publicly documented surface; referenced, not invoked)

endpoints.purpose: live authority grant binding (actorId/principalId + digest-bound statement)
endpoints.note: mapped object is a DERIVED candidate; live grant requires authorized credential

endpoints.purpose: consent artifact registration scoped to the pinned agreement
endpoints.note: artifact IDs are assigned by the platform after submission

endpoints.purpose: evidenceExporter export of the canonical, pinned evidence manifest
endpoints.note: RFC 8785 canonical manifest; artifacts individually pinned and verifiable

endpoints.purpose: authority-bound settlement binding naming allowed actions + authority corpus
endpoints.note: an Award does not move money; execution needs a separately scoped settlement credential

endpoints.purpose: dispute declaration + consent-aware adjudication initiation (idempotencyKey, authorityGrantId, consentArtifactIds)
endpoints.note: packet integrity + party/amount bindings verified before transport

rulesPin.note: the platform's governing Rules are pinned at submission; CoreGuard records the reference, it does not author the rules.

authority.derivedFrom: ADO.layers consent.parties (modeled) — DERIVED, not live authority
authority.label: DERIVED
authority.note: A live authority grant additionally requires an authorized People's Court credential and the platform's confirmation binding (actorId/principalId + digest-bound statement).

consentArtifact.label: VERIFIED_LABELS
consentArtifact.note: modeledAssent is an EVP/1 derived tri-state; it is never converted into an assertion of bilateral real-world consent. Artifact IDs are assigned by the platform after evidence submission.

evidenceExport.label: SHA256_PINNED
evidenceExport.note: evidenceExporter-style export: canonical manifest with individually pinned, verifiable artifacts. Authenticity challenges affect contested weight at adjudication, never automatic exclusion.

settlementBinding.executionBoundary: An Award does not move money. Execution is separate and requires a settlement adapter credential scoped to exactly these actions within this authority corpus. decision_served never triggers execution without that separately scoped credential.
settlementBinding.label: AUTHORITY_BOUND
settlementBinding.note: CoreGuard escrow is reference-only in this record. No settlement instruction may be issued without a real signed award over this package's bytes and an authority-bound credential.

credentialsRequired.name: channelToken
credentialsRequired.purpose: authenticated channel to the Partner API

disclaimer: This is a dry-run structural template, not a live submission. No credential is embedded, no network call is made, and no settlement authority is asserted or implied.
